purpose: Agent-accessible data source roster for rich match analysis. Research and planning only — not runtime configuration, not permission to scrape, and not a substitute for fixture-registry or club-strength release gates.

sources.name: ESPN
sources.notes: Technical primary for enabled competitions (eng.1, uefa.champions, uefa.champions_qual). 30-minute bounded refresh via football-data.ts. Undocumented public JSON; Disney terms restrict automated extraction without written permission. See packages/api/data/research/fixture-sources/coverage-matrix.json. Never match fixtures on canonical name alone — retain ESPN stable IDs.

sources.name: FBref
sources.notes: Stats Perform / Opta-derived tables (xG, possession, passing, defensive actions). Agent may cite for prose context on form and style; numbers do not enter the Dixon-Coles forecast. No bounded server fetch today.

sources.name: The Analyst
sources.notes: Opta-powered editorial and data journalism (formerly Opta Analyst). Useful for tactical framing and verified stat-led narratives. Evidence-only; not a structured ingestion contract.

sources.name: WhoScored
sources.notes: Opta-backed ratings and predicted XI. Listed in REPUTABLE_EVIDENCE_DOMAINS for team-news and lineup evidence. Predicted lineups are not confirmed starters; cite with date and treat as corroboration, not model input.

sources.name: Transfermarkt
sources.notes: Squad lists, injury/suspension pages, and transfer context. Reputable evidence domain for player and availability questions. Does not supply fixture IDs; fixture scope must come from ESPN grounding first.

sources.name: Statbunker
sources.notes: Historical PL and cup stat compendium. Useful for head-to-head and season-long counting stats in agent prose. No public API; search snippets only.

sources.name: FotMob
sources.notes: Mobile-first live scores with xG and lineup cards. Reputable evidence domain. Good for near-kickoff lineup confirmation when search returns a dated match page tied to the grounded fixture.

sources.name: SofaScore
sources.notes: Ratings, lineups, and live event data in search results. Reputable evidence domain. Same fixture-scoping rule as other analytics sites — must reference the grounded matchup, not club names in isolation.

sources.name: FootyStats
sources.notes: Aggregated league and match tendency stats (BTTS%, O/U rates). Useful for contextual prose; do not treat as Pundit probabilities or blend into Fundamental. Comparison and narrative only.

sources.name: BBC Sport
sources.notes: Primary UK wire for breaking team news and confirmed lineups. Reputable evidence domain. Positive availability claims require same-sentence dated citation per Analyst V2 contract.

sources.name: Goal.com
sources.notes: Global football news and preview content. Reputable evidence domain. Corroborate injury and lineup claims with a second source when possible.

sources.name: CBS Sports
sources.notes: US-facing soccer coverage and previews. Reputable evidence domain. Useful for UCL and PL context in general-analysis turns; not a fixture spine.

sources.name: Premier League (official)
sources.notes: Competition-organizer authority for PL schedule changes, postponements, and official statements. OFFICIAL_EVIDENCE_DOMAIN. Terms prohibit database scraping without written approval; do not automate ingestion. See fixture-sources coverage-matrix premier-league-web-ecal entry.

sources.name: UEFA
sources.notes: Organizer authority for UCL and qualifiers. OFFICIAL_EVIDENCE_DOMAIN. UEFA terms prohibit systematic collection and automated scraping. Corroborate venue, neutral-site, and status conflicts; never reverse-engineer internal payloads.

sources.name: Oddschecker
sources.notes: Odds aggregator across UK books. Reputable evidence domain; used in player-evidence tests for scorer markets. Compare-only for 1X2 — never blend into Fundamental or Consensus without explicit labelled refit. Player markets are evidence, not Pundit projections.

sources.name: Oddsportal
sources.notes: Historical and live odds comparison site. Reputable evidence domain. Agent may cite market disagreement in prose; production comparison spine remains Stake/Kalshi/Polymarket bounded fetch where configured.

sources.name: API-Football
sources.notes: Paid RapidAPI vendor bundling fixtures, stats, and odds. Deferred — candidate unified feed behind fixture-market-sources.ts seam per GOAL.md / product vision. Would require license review, identity mapping to ESPN IDs, and explicit product decision before any server-owned fetch. Not a workaround for ESPN rights review.

sources.name: StatsPerform (Opta)
sources.notes: Enterprise parent of Opta. Powers FBref, The Analyst, and many broadcast graphics under license. Deferred — no commercial contract in Pundit today. Would be the path to fitted Dixon-Coles event feeds (Phase 2+) if licensed; do not substitute scraped Opta pages for a feed.

sources.name: StatsBomb Open Data
sources.notes: Free CC-licensed event JSON for selected competitions (WC, WWC, La Liga sample, etc.). Deferred for agent runtime — useful offline for methodology research and challenger training prototypes. Does not cover live PL/UCL qualifying windows; not a production spine.

sources.name: Stake
sources.notes: GraphQL public adapter in fixture-market-sources.ts. 30-minute cache via model-market-odds.ts. Compare-only; Cloudflare has blocked production adapter (pre-next-phase QA 2026-09-15). Never enter Fundamental forecast. Returns no-vig probabilities, not tradable decimals.

sources.name: Kalshi
sources.notes: Elections trade API (KXEPLGAME, KXUCLGAME series). Bounded fetch with fixture name matching. Compare-only. Coverage often 0/N on active slates; failures stay isolated. US-regulated prediction-market prices normalized to no-vig 1X2.

sources.name: Polymarket
sources.notes: Gamma API public events search. Usually the strongest active comparison source (11/11 PL fixtures observed 2026-09-15). Compare-only. Labelled Pundit Consensus may shrink toward one complete same-source no-vig market — still not Fundamental.

sources.name: ClubElo (pinned artifact)
sources.notes: Reviewed content-addressed clubelo@1 snapshot in packages/api/data/model-artifacts/clubelo/. Runtime never contacts ClubElo. Hash, coverage, and 30-day freshness fail closed. Refresh via refresh:clubelo-snapshot release workflow only. Historical pre-kickoff corpus is a separate offline research path (clubelo-history/).
